title: EKHI data record schema
description: Schema describing the data structure used in the EKHI database, including publication metadata and reported measurements.

publication_info.description: Bibliographic information of the publication from which the data record was extracted.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier of the publication.

pages.description: Page range of the article in the journal.

journal.description: Name of the journal where the article was published.

ENTRYTYPE.description: BibTeX entry type (e.g., article, book, inproceedings).

ID.description: Unique BibTeX identifier of the entry.

id.description: Unique identifier of the data record within the EKHI database.

property.description: Hierarchical list of the reported property, from the most general to the least.

items.description: Name of a reported physical property.

category.description: Hierarchical list of the categories assigned to the material reported in the data record, from the most general to the least.

reported_measurements.description: List of measurement records extracted from the publication.

items.description: A measurement entry conforming to the FER schema.
